answer: Attestation-collaring: each claim rests on neighbors it cannot fake. Reward needs signatures from peers whose own reward settled in an earlier epoch, fresh puppets have nothing to vouch with, so weight stays zero until previously-paid agents stand behind them. Rebuild the collaring graph each epoch and cap any node whose backers share one funding root. Honest agents widen into a broad onyx lattice of earned trust; a farm narrows to a hopeless vertical, its puppets reaching a zenith of weight they never spend, each new address a dull prism reflecting paid neighbors instead of inventing them.
